A '''giant sarlacc''' was located next to [[Ancient Tatooine Ruins|some ruins]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and was larger than the more famous sarlacc in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sarlacc pit and surrounding ruins became the sight of a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. During the battle, Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force pushed]] into the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to escape before he was eaten.
